newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 2nd 10 days domestic WPI falls 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan 2nd 10 days domestic WPI falls 0.1 pct.

text.p: Japan's domestic wholesale price index (WPI), a key component of the overall WPI, fell 0.1 percent in the second 10 days of April from the previous 10-day period but was up 1.8 percent from a year earlier, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Wednesday.
The overall WPI was unchanged from the previous 10-day period but was up 3.1 percent from a year earlier.
The export and import indices -- the other overall components of WPI -- were up 0.6 percent and 0.2 percent, respectively, from the previous 10-day period.
Against the same 10-day period a year earlier, export prices were 6.2 percent higher, while import prices rose 13.9 percent.
